puzzle.goal: An antiproton of charge q moves with velocity v through a trap made of an electrostatic potential and a strong magnetic field. Write the full force on it in terms of the scalar potential and the vector potential A (from which the magnetic field B is derived), including the magnetic part that bends it into circles.
puzzle.name: Lorentz force (in terms of potentials)
puzzle.form: q * ( - grad ( Φ ) - pd ( vec ( A ) , t ) + vec ( v ) × vec ( B ) )
puzzle.ask: In a uniform field the magnetic part makes the particle circle at the frequency f = qB/(2πm). Find it in MHz for an antiproton (charge magnitude q, mass m) in the field given.
puzzle.method: The electric field is minus the gradient of the potential minus the rate of change of the vector potential; the magnetic force is the cross product of velocity and field.
